title: Example: Papyrus Basics
tagline: Tavern actions for NPCs and tavern events for SkyrimNet, written in Papyrus and YAML.
description:
The first SkyrimNet plugin example. NPCs can buy a round, share a drink or tell a tale, grouped under one Tavern Manners category. The player's visits to inns are reported to SkyrimNet as events.

**Requires:** ExampleBasics.esp (shipped with this mod).
author: example
